components: Queueing, deadlines, or resource saturation cross a safe threshold.
Traffic is labeled by criticality, cost, and remaining deadline.
Low-value or hopeless work is rejected before consuming scarce resources.
Reserved capacity continues serving high-value requests.
Shedding relaxes only after health remains below the recovery threshold.
